text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: Severity=2 -> model-catalog: model 'redwood-qa/llama2-70b' default revision mismatch + tokenizer validation failures. Pager: @sasha. See PD: https://pagerduty.example/INC12345

PagerDuty: Trigger: model-config-revision-mismatch, rule=catalog-validation, 78 errors in last 2m, affected routes: /v1/generate (us-west-2).

sasha: acked. I'm jumping on this. Pulling logs now.

alex: on the way. any clue if this is a bad revision promotion or tokenizer metadata?

sasha: logs show tokenization exceptions like `TokenizationError: unknown token id -1` from the tokenizer registry when loading rev `rev_20260307`. Previous rev `rev_20260201` was fine.

mira: copying a small log sample from validator: ```
[2026-03-14T03:21:12Z] model=redwood-qa/llama2-70b rev=rev_20260307 validator=tokenizer-check error=Token length mismatch expected=502 got=0
[2026-03-14T03:21:14Z] model=redwood-qa/llama2-70b rev=rev_20260307 loader=kv-cache msg="bad tokenizer metadata: tokenizer.vocab missing"
```

jamal: customer impact: three tenants reported garbled outputs and one enterprise customer hit timeouts when the app tried to recover. Severity=customer-impact-high for that tenant.

alex: can we flip the catalog default back to `rev_20260201` as an emergency rollback? If rollback works, route will be healthy in <60s.

sasha: I can do that. Running the rollback command now: 
```bash
# rollback catalog default
catalogctl set-default --model redwood-qa/llama2-70b --rev rev_20260201 --reason "emergency rollback - tokenizer mismatch in rev_20260307" --force
```

sasha: executed. API says success. Pushing config to control plane.

incident-bot: Started propagation to serving fleet. Expected propagation time: ~30-90s. Notifying downstream routers.

mira: updating routing policy to prefer stable variant until we validate the new rev: 
```json
{"model":"redwood-qa/llama2-70b","route_policy":"prefer:rev_20260201,fallback_to:rev_20260307,hold_time":3600}
```

alex: saw the rollback propagate. Monitoring traces for errors. Early signs: 200->500 error rate for /v1/generate dropped from 12% to 0.6% in the last 20s.

jamal: confirming with customers — the enterprise tenant reports responses are normal again, latency improved. Marking customer-affected=false (for active outage) pending postmortem.

sasha: filing immediate follow-up: I'm creating an incident in #incidents with notes and probe IDs. Will also open a model onboarding checklist failure ticket.

sasha: quick action items: 1) revert already done; 2) block `rev_20260307` from promotions until QA fixes tokenizer metadata; 3) run tokenizer-only validation tests in CI gating for this model family; 4) assign owner for root cause.

mira: i'm taking ownership of CI gating changes. will draft PR to add validator rule by EOD.

alex: i'll own the post-rollback verification and dig through the promotion job logs to see how the tokenizer metadata got stripped.

jamal: i'll notify customer success for the affected tenants and prepare an incident summary for them.

incident-bot: PagerDuty INC12345 acknowledged by sasha at 1977770003.

sasha: hopping out for a short handoff. @alex you take postmortem and longer-term mitigation. @mira you own gating. @jamal handle customer comms. I'll leave a runbook note in the incident doc.

alex: acknowledged, taking over. Adding `oncall-next` for handoff at 1977770060.

mira: noted. i'll start the PR and include a test vector that reproduces the tokenization mismatch.

jamal: prepping CS message template now. we'll avoid blaming wording and emphasize mitigation + timeline.

sasha: thanks team. closing this channel after handoff. I'll post the incident link in #postmortems once the doc is ready. :thumbsup:
